message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 (`npm test`).

The failure was in the test, not the code. `test/vat.test.js` expected `withVat(250)` to be 301, but 20% VAT on 250p is 50p, so the correct total is 300p. I changed that expected value to 300 and left `src/vat.js` unchanged. The other assertions were already correct.

I haven't committed the change. The only edit is that one line in `test/vat.test.js`.
